parts.name: Blade Handle Set
parts.Basic_description: This part consists of one blade and its corresponding handle, typically made of stainless steel for the blade and plastic for the handle.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as one half of the cutting mechanism, providing one cutting edge and one handle for gripping and applying force.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around the central screw pivot to open and close against the other blade handle set.

parts.name: Blade Handle Set
parts.Basic_description: This part is the second blade and handle combination, mirroring the first set, made of stainless steel and plastic.
parts.Functional_description: It forms the other half of the cutting pair, working in conjunction with the first blade to shear materials.
parts.Movement_description: It pivots around the screw to move in opposition to the first blade handle set, enabling the cutting action.

parts.name: Screw
parts.Basic_description: A small steel screw that connects the two blade handle sets at their pivot point.
parts.Functional_description: It acts as the pivot joint, allowing the two blades to rotate relative to each other while maintaining alignment.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary while allowing rotational movement of the two blade handle sets around it.
